(2) Four FILTERED strace legs through the same harness launch via a product.yaml binary swap (asserted per leg, restored+grep-asserted after; launch-open's INVALID-matrix lesson): network-only (all pids), openat-only (all pids), TUI-only read/recvfrom/connect (NO -f: the daemon/worker/pythons run untraced = NEAR-CLEAN TUI-side wire view), execve-only (all pids: exact spawn argv). decision: BOOT FLOOR LEDGER at 7064d039a (small fixture, clean p50 paint 330.5ms): exec->daemon fork 9.4ms; daemon boot->bind 39.2ms (inside it: the supervisor-config atomic-write fsync ~31ms, already measured and REJECTED by the daemon-boot lane - do not resurrect); TUI 25ms probe grid 1.6-25ms (mean ~12.5); census+hello+create ~1.5-2ms (CORRECTION: the /proc census is ~1-3ms clean, not a floor cost - launch-open's 151ms traced span was strace amplification; #289 semantics untouched, quantified only); create->worker fork+exec+bind ~1-3ms (worker boot is FAST); supervisor 25ms worker-socket probe grid ~12.5ms mean; THEN THE DOMINANT SEGMENT: worker create-replay window ~180-220ms (response ~+281 vs create ~+64) whose content is the PER-OPEN KERNEL-VENV PROBE CHAIN - installed_runtime_identity content walk (~20-40ms) + python -c RUNTIME_READY_CHECK (~55-75ms) + python -c 'import dill' (~35-40ms) - because #2857's runtime-ready memo is PROCESS-GLOBAL and every cold open boots a FRESH worker (the memo never helps the open path by construction); plus session load (10-25ms small) and routing. Tail: create response -> direct transport -> peer_auth -> attach -> snapshot -> render -> paint ~24ms; paint->ready ~13.5ms. Real fixture: identical fixed floor + create->response ~448ms (the file passes are launch-open's domain; their approved windowed-first candidate cuts ~130-150ms of it). FIX-LANE CANDIDATES, dominant first: (1) cross-process (on-disk) memo for the runtime-ready probe chain, extending #2857 with the SAME identity inputs (content-hash key preserved: a miss still re-probes, damage detection intact) - est. ~90-115ms off EVERY cold open, small AND real; coordinate with the kernel-boot lane (their scope was the in-process ensure, NOT the open path; this is a follow-up on new evidence, not a resurrection of the discarded records); (2) tighten the two 25ms probe grids (TUI daemon-connect + supervisor worker-connect) to ~5ms with the same timeout budgets - ~20-25ms mean combined, worst ~50ms, timing-only change (wire, error messages, and DAEMON_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS unchanged); needs adversarial review for TS-parity posture (the intervals mirror TS ensureDaemonRunning/connectWorker); (3) census: NOT a target (correction above); (4) daemon-boot fsync: rejected previously, stands. NO single >=50% lever inside the floor alone: candidate (1) is ~1/3 of the small-fixture floor and ~1/5 of the real-fixture open; (1)+(2) together ~40% of the floor.
